criteria.label: Lossless public-safe intake
criteria.intent: Every supplied fragment receives a stable ID, project association, disposition, boundary, and next relationship rather than disappearing silently.

criteria.label: Observation atomicity
criteria.intent: Sources are decomposed into proposition-level observations with locators, limitations, and explicit links to claims or research questions.

criteria.label: Evidence scope integrity
criteria.intent: Every source records what it establishes and does not establish; evidence relationships never silently broaden a source.

criteria.label: Claim maturation
criteria.intent: Defensible claims carry evidence, boundaries, anti-claims, review data, and open inquiries where material uncertainty remains.

criteria.label: Projection discipline
criteria.intent: Epistemic readiness remains separate from compositional selection; held claims have no public surface and active claims have an authorized page plan.

criteria.label: Existing-site evidence coverage
criteria.intent: The framework improves support for consequential claims already represented on the public site, without overloading the composition.

criteria.label: Public safety and collective credit
criteria.intent: No private locator or raw archive leaks; participant detail, policy causation, and collective outcomes remain explicitly bounded.

criteria.label: Recomposition and feedback readiness
criteria.intent: Unselected claims and open questions remain usable for future applications, site arguments, collaborator proofs, and photo-editor feedback loops.

criteria.label: Campaign press archive completeness
criteria.intent: Every press-list appearance across the four campaign sites is preserved with campaign provenance, deduplicated article identity, availability context, scope boundaries, and a maturation disposition.

criteria.label: KC Town Hall funding lifecycle integrity
criteria.intent: The bank and public projection preserve the full official sequence from CCED recommendation through Council acceptance and appropriation to zero disbursement, withdrawal, and return of the unused funds, without converting collective authorization into individual receipt or sole causation.

criteria.label: Teams archive production integrity
criteria.intent: Jamie Projects History, CRS, and job-hunt produce bounded sources, atomic observations, held depth, explicit hydration limits, and only one independently supported public projection without exposing private archive material.

criteria.label: Google Drive Shared Drives production integrity
criteria.intent: The 110-drive corpus receives a bounded non-exhaustive map, high-signal close reading, cross-carrier deduplication, protected source handling, collective credit, one strengthened existing projection, and held depth without exposing Shared Drive identifiers or participant records.

criteria.label: Project social-media archive production integrity
criteria.intent: Five verified project accounts receive bounded authenticated inventories, official-at-date engagement counts, source and authorship limits, collective credit, one inspectable CallNYC projection, and held archival depth without exposing private account data or mistaking project outreach for official engagement.

criteria.label: CallNYC full-population archival integrity
criteria.intent: Every recoverable @CallNYCApp item and posted URL is preserved in an item-level ledger; all 110 observed profile-count slots receive honest dispositions; stakeholder outreach remains distinct from reciprocal engagement; mission-relevant sources and claims mature without inflating tags, rows, links, or visible metrics into outcomes.

criteria.label: WOW List full-population archival integrity
criteria.intent: Every surviving @wowlist item and posted URL is dispositioned; support and stakeholder patterns are reproducible; current reactions remain bounded; collective authorship is preserved; and only the clearest operational claim is composed into the site.

criteria.label: KC Town Hall full-population archival integrity
criteria.intent: Every surviving @KCTownHall item and posted URL is dispositioned; resident-service, source-routing, and stakeholder patterns are reproducible; outreach, direct response, amplification, and current reactions remain distinct; private contact and service data stay absent; collective authorship is preserved; and only the clearest operational claim is composed into the site.

criteria.label: NYC Artist Coalition population-reconciled archival integrity
criteria.intent: All 5,124 displayed @NYCArtC profile-count slots receive honest dispositions; every recovered item and posted URL is preserved without raw text; unresolved carrier gaps remain explicit; source authorship, coalition amplification, direct mention, current reactions, and Council-member engagement remain distinct; and the deeper account record stays available for recomposition without burdening the public portfolio.

criteria.label: Personal @urbanhermit population-reconciled archival integrity
criteria.intent: All 434 displayed personal-account slots receive honest dispositions; mission-relevant public evidence remains inspectable; ordinary and protected life context is counted without republication; source-status authorship and metrics remain with their source; self-report, outside corroboration, mutable reactions, and impact remain distinct; and all newly matured claims stay held until deliberate composition.

criteria.label: NYC Artist Coalition Facebook event population integrity
criteria.intent: All 34 displayed Facebook event slots are honestly dispositioned; 33 recovered events remain useful historical plot points; rotating venues, event formats, source routes, and retrieval drift are reproducible; responses never become attendance; private people and access data remain absent; collective authorship is preserved; and only Jamie's bounded participation-system contribution is composed into the public site.

criteria.intent: All current personal event controls are population-reconciled; the complete displayed-Jamie subset becomes bounded historical plot points; source routes and independent reporting are retained; personal relationship data stays protected; mutable platform displays never become attendance or impact; and WOW List's current zero and historical non-recovery remain distinct.

criteria.label: WOW List Facebook post population integrity
criteria.intent: Every surviving WOW List Facebook post receives a public-safe disposition; independent traversals reconcile; explicit routes and selected source articles remain inspectable; wider participant relationships stay aggregate-only; publisher action, shared authorship, sole management, mutable reactions, stakeholder response, and impact remain distinct; and only the bounded Page-publishing claim enters the portfolio.

iteration: Run deterministic checks and a fresh editorial judge against the current bank.
Select the lowest criterion and state one bounded maturation hypothesis.
Improve structure, research, or projection without deleting protected boundaries.
Rerun checks, public-safety validation, and the affected public projection.
Keep only iterations that improve the lowest criterion without regressions.
antiGaming: Never call a memory a verified claim without a source relationship.
Never improve completeness by placing private paths or raw evidence in the public repo.
Never improve projection coverage by publishing every mature claim.
Never infer sole causation from participation, proximity, or contemporaneous coverage.
Never treat a photograph as self-interpreting proof or consent to publish.
Never turn an appropriation into money received, omit a material later disposition, or erase a documented approval because the project later changed course.
Never count a project account tagging an official as engagement authored by that official.
Never count candidate-era or former-member posts as sitting-officeholder engagement.
Never treat profile post totals as stable impact metrics or individual authorship records.
Never count reactions on a reposted source status as engagement earned by the project account's repost action.
Never call a public personal-account record opaque if its identifier, digest, timestamp, length, metric tuple, or other fingerprint can be linked back to a withheld item.
Never turn project-authored mentions or project-selected reposts into engagement authored by an outside stakeholder.
Never turn a tire-workflow record count into a completed-pickup, household, or resident-outcome count.
Never turn an unrecovered account or status into proof that it never existed.
hillClimb.stopWhen: Every criterion meets its minimum and the weighted target passes in two consecutive fresh-judge runs, with deterministic checks and public safety passing.
